ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  Central Depository Services (India) Limited (CDSL) announced SEBI approval for a Joint Venture between its subsidiary, Centrico Insurance Repository, and Shoveltech Solutions Private Limited. This strategic partnership involves a Rs. 25 Lakh investment for developing a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) in software, signaling CDSL's move into new technological offerings. A key condition of the approval is CDSL's ongoing maintenance of its regulatory net worth, which is a material compliance requirement rather than an immediate red flag given its standard regulatory context.
